This names three outcomes and a plan to test first through pilots, which goes beyond a bare indication of success measures. Together this reaches level 2: it gives details of testing (pilots) and outcome measures, and a monitoring plan. To reach level 3 the document would need to explain why pilots are the right approach, give how and when outcomes will be measured and evaluated, and commit to publishing results and acting on them.
